items.question: In what year was the UAE federal law promulgating the Pensions and Social Security Law issued?
items.fact: Federal Law No. 7 promulgating Pensions and Social Security Law, 1999.

items.question: Which cabinet resolution approved the National Uniform Classification of Disabilities (People of Determination) in the UAE?
items.fact: Cabinet Resolution No. 3 of 2018 approved national disability classification.
